JOURNAL_MISSIONS.desc: Today your Pokemon journey begins! Head for Route 1, north of Pallet Town. Professor Oak won't let you into the tall grass without a Pokemon.
Professor Oak has three Pokemon in the Poke Balls on his lab table. Walk up to one and pick your first partner!
Go north through Route 1 to Viridian City. The Poke Mart there has a parcel for Professor Oak.
Take the parcel back to Professor Oak's lab in Pallet Town. He has something for you too!
{rival_name} went off west of Viridian City, toward the Pokemon League's gate on Route 22. Go and show him how your Pokemon is doing!
Pewter City lies north, past Route 2 and the winding paths of Viridian Forest. Bug Catchers hide among the trees!
Professor Oak heard you beat Lt. Surge. He has an Electric Pokemon at his Lab in Pallet Town that might listen to a trainer like you!
Check out the Viridian City Gym. People say the Gym Leader is away, but strange characters have been seen there.
Head north through Route 2 and Viridian Forest to reach Pewter City. Earn your first badge from Brock, the rock-solid Gym Leader!
With the Boulder Badge in hand, head east through Route 3 and the depths of Mt. Moon to find Cerulean City.
Challenge Misty at the Cerulean City Gym. You might need to visit her friend on Route 25 first!
Journey south through Route 5 and the Underground Path to reach Vermilion City, the port of Kanto.

North of Cerulean City, cross Nugget Bridge (Route 24): five trainers wait on it, and {rival_name} too. Then follow Route 25 east to Bill's Sea Cottage at the very end. Bill, the man who made the PC Storage System, needs your help, and he'll give you a ticket for the S.S. Anne.
Challenge Lt. Surge at the Vermilion City Gym. His Electric-type Pokémon are lightning fast!

A small tree blocks the way to Vermilion's Gym, and only Cut can clear it. The S.S. Anne is docked at the harbour at the south end of town: show your S.S. Ticket and go aboard. The Captain's cabin is at the back of the ship, up on 2F. He's seasick! Help him out and he'll give you HM Cut. Teach it to a Pokémon from the Bag, and hurry: the ship sails once you leave.
Travel north from Vermilion back to Cerulean, then head east through Route 9 and Route 10 to brave the Rock Tunnel.

A restless spirit haunts the Pokémon Tower. You'll need a Silph Scope to see it. Team Rocket in Celadon might have one... With the Silph Scope, climb the Tower: the ghost blocks the stairs on 6F, and Mr. Fuji is held on 7F. Once he's free, visit him at his house in Lavender Town.
Lavender's Radio Tower has no power! Surf along the channel on Route 10 to the Power Plant and help the manager fix the generator.
Travel west through Route 8 and Route 7 to reach Celadon City. Challenge Erika for the Rainbow Badge!

Team Rocket is up to something in Celadon's Game Corner. A grunt stands guard by the poster at the back of the room. Beat him, then check the poster: there's a switch behind it, and stairs open in the corner, down to Team Rocket's hideout.

The hideout's floors are a maze of arrow tiles that whisk you along: watch where each one points. Take the stairs all the way down to B4F, beat the grunt there and pick up the Lift Key he drops. The elevator on B1F or B2F then takes you down to the far side of B4F, where Giovanni, Team Rocket's boss, is waiting. Beat him and take the Silph Scope.

Travel south to Fuchsia City. A Snorlax sleeps across Route 12, south of Lavender Town: wake it with the Poke Flute, then follow Routes 12 to 15. With a Bicycle, Cycling Road (Routes 16-18) is the fast way!
Challenge Koga at the Fuchsia City Gym. His poison and traps are legendary!

The guards at Saffron City's gates won't let anyone by: they're parched! An old woman in Celadon Mansion, the tall building in the north of Celadon City, will give you some Tea. Bring it to any of Saffron's four gatehouses and the guard will let you through.

The Safari Zone's Warden has lost his Gold Teeth and can't talk! They're lying in the Safari Zone's west area. Take them back to his house in Fuchsia City and he'll give you HM Strength. You'll need it for the boulders of Victory Road.
Deep in Fuchsia's Safari Zone, past its west area, stands the Secret House. The man inside gives HM Surf to anyone who makes it that far. With Koga's Soul Badge, Surf carries you over the sea.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.text: Silph Co. Takeover: the Card Key
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.desc: Team Rocket has seized Silph Co., the tall building in the middle of Saffron City, and their grunts block Saffron's Gym until they're driven out. Inside, the Rockets have locked many doors. Don't worry about them yet: take the stairs in the top-right corner of each floor up to 5F. The Card Key that opens every locked door is lying on 5F's floor, in the bottom corridor.

You have the Card Key! Go back down to 3F and open the locked door in the middle of the floor. The warp pad behind it carries you straight up to 7F, where {rival_name} is waiting. Step on the warp pad in that same room to reach 11F, then follow the corridor around to the boardroom: Giovanni, Team Rocket's boss, is holding the President there. Beat him to free Silph Co.

Silph Co. is free! The President is in his boardroom on 11F and wants to thank you. (The quick way up: the warp pad behind 3F's middle door to 7F, then 7F's pad to 11F.) While you're in the building, a worker in 7F's locked room has a gift for you too.
Now that Saffron City is accessible, challenge Sabrina at the Saffron Gym for your sixth badge!
Surf to Cinnabar Island: south from Pallet Town down Route 21, or from Fuchsia through Routes 19 and 20 and the Seafoam Islands.
Challenge Blaine at the Cinnabar Island Gym. Only a burning math spirit can win here! Inside, answer the quiz machines' questions: each right answer opens the next gate on the way to Blaine.

Cinnabar's Gym is locked, and its key is somewhere in the burned-out Pokémon Mansion at the north of the island. Its halls are blocked by heavy gates: the Pokémon statues hide secret switches, and each press swings every gate in the Mansion the other way. The Secret Key lies down in the basement.
The Viridian Gym Leader has finally returned. Head back to Viridian City to earn your final badge!
With 8 badges, travel west from Viridian through Victory Road: push its boulders onto the floor switches with Strength. The Elite Four awaits at the Indigo Plateau!
An old man is blocking the path in Viridian City. People say he needs a math genius to wake him up... and he might have a handy gift!
A scientist waits by the back door of the Pewter Museum of Science. You'll need Cut (the Cascade Badge) to reach it.
A Super Nerd has dug up two fossils deep inside Mt. Moon. Beat him and pick one!
Bill is looking for a trainer who can clear the Nugget Bridge challenge on Route 24. Beat all its trainers, then visit him.
Bill wants to see a real Snorlax. He's heard rumors of one blocking paths near Lavender Town. Catch one and show him!
Bill is fascinated by long tongues. Bring him a Lickitung, rumored to live in the Safari Zone.
You have a Bike Voucher! Visit the Bike Shop in Cerulean City to claim your miracle cycle.
The Chairman of Vermilion's Pokemon Fan Club loves to talk about his Pokemon. Listen right to the end and he'll give you a Bike Voucher for Cerulean's Bike Shop.
One of Professor Oak's aides waits in the gatehouse on Route 2, at the Diglett's Cave end. Show him you've caught 10 kinds of Pokemon and he'll give you HM Flash, to light up dark caves.
A girl hides away in a house on Route 16, behind the small tree just west of Celadon City. Find her and she'll give you HM Fly, to fly back to any town you've visited.
Talk to Mr. Fuji in Lavender Town now that the Pokémon Tower ghost is at peace.
Team Rocket's hideout is under the Celadon Game Corner. Their boss is said to have a Silph Scope.
A Snorlax blocks Route 12, south of Lavender Town. Use the Poké Flute to wake it up.
A second Snorlax sleeps on Route 16, west of Celadon City, blocking Cycling Road.
A hidden island is said to appear in the sea near Cinnabar Island. Explore it to find rare Pokémon.
A cave hidden in the depths of Mt. Moon is said to contain rare Pokémon and treasures.
The Fighting Dojo in Saffron rewards those who have proven their strength against Sabrina.
The Dojo Master promised another gift if you defeat Koga in Fuchsia City.
Revive ancient Pokémon from fossils at the Pokemon Lab on Cinnabar Island.
Deep within the Seafoam Islands on Route 20, an ice-cold legend awaits.
An intense crackle of electricity emanates from the Abandoned Power Plant near Route 10. Zapdos awaits a challenger!
The legendary bird of fire nests at the top of Mt. Ember on One Island. Take the Seagallop Ferry from Cinnabar or Vermilion, then follow Kindle Road.
A guard still blocks Cerulean Cave. He'll stand aside for a Champion once Celio's Network Machine on One Island is running: bring Celio the Ruby and the Sapphire from the Sevii Islands.
A secret cave near Cerulean City has opened. Only a Champion may enter to face the ultimate challenge.
A keen fisherman lives in the house on Route 12's pier, south of Lavender Town. Visit him and he'll give you his best rod, the Super Rod.
You can't play at Celadon's Game Corner without a Coin Case. A man in the restaurant in the south of Celadon City has one he no longer wants.
Celadon Mansion is taller than it looks. Someone has left a Poke Ball up at the very top, behind the back stairs, as if it's waiting for a new friend.
With Team Rocket gone, the workers of Silph Co. are coming out of hiding. One of them, behind a door that used to be locked, wants to give you something big.
A man at the Pokemon Center by Mt. Moon is selling something he swears is 'a real deal'. Is it?
People all over Kanto are hoping to swap one Pokemon for another. Bring them what they ask for and see what they give you back.
Own 30 different Kanto Pokémon to earn a $5,000 bonus.
Own 60 different Kanto Pokémon to earn another $5,000 bonus.
Own 90 different Kanto Pokémon to earn another $5,000 bonus.
Own 120 different Kanto Pokémon to earn another $5,000 bonus.
Own all 150 Kanto Pokémon to earn the final $5,000 bonus!
